verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships an official MCP server and management APIs. The evidence shows programmatic access to customer 360 data through a real-time API and the ability to programmatically run Reverse ETL syncs, which covers querying and partial activation without the dashboard. However, the documented MCP tools cover debugging, transformations, tracking plans and audit logs, not audiences. No evidence shows an API or MCP tool that creates or activates Audiences, so the end-to-end loop is incomplete. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP endpoints for creating audiences, programmatic audience activation to destinations, MCP tools for customer-data querying and segmentation, and hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can query customer data and create or activate audiences end to end through documented APIs or MCP — no dashboard in the loop
